how_to_apply: Download the application format (Annexure-II) from www.mumbaiport.gov.in, under the People & Career/ Jobs/ Advertisements/ Contractual/ Other Engagements menu.
Fill in the application format with all required details and the declaration.
Attach self-attested copies of documents/ certificates relating to age, qualification, and experience, and enclose two references from your field with their contact details.
Send the completed application to the address below before the last date, 12.10.2026: The Chief Engineer, Civil Engineering Department, Port House, 3rd Floor, Shoorji Vallabhdas Marg, Mumbai – 400001
Superscribe the envelope as: "Application for the post of ___ on contract basis."

Note: Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026 uses an offline (postal) application process; the notification does not mention an online application/ apply-online facility. Merely submitting a resume/ CV, or an incomplete application, will lead to rejection, and delayed applications will not be accepted. Original certificates must be produced for verification at any subsequent stage of the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026 is assessed as on the crucial date of 01.09.2026 for educational qualification, experience, and age. Only candidates who fulfil the essential qualification, experience, and age criteria for a post should apply, and a separate application must be submitted for each post if a candidate wishes to apply for more than one. Qualifications must be from recognized Indian Universities approved by the UGC, recognized Indian Institutes, or recognized International Universities. Only experience gained after acquiring the essential qualification will be counted. Candidates must clearly indicate the percentage of marks in the application form; CGPA must be converted to the equivalent percentage as per the issuing University/ Institution's own conversion criteria.

content_sections.heading: Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not describe the selection process in full detail. It does state that no TA/ DA will be paid for appearing in a written test/ interview, which indicates that the selection process includes a written test and/ or interview stage. Beyond this, further stages (such as shortlisting criteria or interview weightage) are not specified in the notification. Decisions of Mumbai Port Authority on eligibility, shortlisting, and selection are stated to be final and binding, with no separate correspondence entertained in this regard.

content_sections.heading: Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026 Terms of Contractual Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract period: 3 years, extendable by 1 more year at the discretion of Mumbai Port Authority. Nature of engagement: Full-time; contractual personnel cannot take up any other assignment during the engagement period. Experience certificate: Issued only on successful completion of the engagement; not issued to those who do not complete at least 1 year. Medical facility: Available at the Mumbai Port Authority hospital/ dispensary along with medicines; no outside referral and no facility for family/ dependents. Leave: 20 days Casual Leave per year plus public holidays, and an additional 7 days of paid leave per annum specifically for seminars, conferences, and workshops. No leave carry-forward or encashment is permitted. Duty hours: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, or as decided by the Administration; a weekly off (normally Sunday) applies, with compensatory rest for work on a weekly off/ national holiday when required. Accommodation: May be provided at Mumbai Port Authority quarters, subject to availability, at a rent of 10% of remuneration per month plus license fee, with electricity and water charged on actual consumption. Other conditions: No right/ title/ interest at par with regular Mumbai Port Authority employees; engagement subject to police verification of antecedents; forfeiture of dues if the contract is left without notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Mumbai Port Authority for 13 contract posts in its Planning Division, covering roles from Advisor (Planning) to Clerk, announced through Advertisement No. CE.CON.03/2026 dated 11.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies across 10 posts: Advisor (Planning) - 1, Chief Manager (Planning)-I - 1, Chief Manager (Planning)-II - 1, Manager (Planning) - 1, Associate Planner - 1, Urban Designer - 2, Deputy Planner - 2, Junior Planner - 2, Document Controller - 1, and Clerk - 1.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 12.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post, ranging from a Graduate degree with a computer certificate course (Document Controller) to a degree in Architecture/Civil Engineering/Planning with a relevant postgraduate qualification and, for several posts, membership of the Institute of Town Planners, India. See the qualification table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limits range from 30 years (Clerk, Document Controller) to 65 years (Advisor, Chief Manager-I, Chief Manager-II), with relaxation for deserving candidates mentioned for most posts. See the qualification table above for exact post-wise age limits.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification provided.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are submitted offline: download the application format from www.mumbaiport.gov.in, fill it, attach self-attested documents, and send it by post to the Chief Engineer, Civil Engineering Department, Port House, Mumbai – 400001, before 12.10.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification indicates a written test and/or interview stage (since it specifies that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in one), but does not detail further stages.
